moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this Friday with Arsenal taking on newly promoted Coventry City in the opening match, followed by a full weekend of fixtures.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: Football is back! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Coventry Opener
angles.copy: Champions Arsenal face newly-promoted Coventry City in the Premier League opener this Friday night. A tricky start for the Sky Blues?

moments.title: All Points East Festival Begins
moments.blurb: London's Victoria Park hosts the first weekend of All Points East 2026 from Friday, featuring headliners like Jorja Smith & Tems, Lorde, and Deftones.

angles.name: Festival Weekend One
angles.copy: All Points East kicks off this Friday in Victoria Park! Who's heading down for Jorja Smith, Lorde, Deftones and more?

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: London is buzzing with festival fever as All Points East brings a huge lineup to Victoria Park for the next two weekends.

moments.title: Creamfields 2026
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest electronic dance music festival, Creamfields, takes over Daresbury, Cheshire, from August 27-30 for the Bank Holiday weekend.

angles.name: Dance Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until Creamfields 2026! Who's ready for four days of the biggest names in electronic music in Cheshire?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Banger
angles.copy: Creamfields is the only place to be for the August Bank Holiday weekend if you love dance music. Get ready to rave!

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival Weekend
moments.blurb: London's iconic Notting Hill Carnival returns for the August Bank Holiday weekend, celebrating Caribbean culture with vibrant parades and music.

angles.name: Carnival Prep
angles.copy: The countdown to Notting Hill Carnival is on! Who's excited for the sights, sounds and incredible atmosphere this Bank Holiday weekend?

angles.name: London's Biggest Street Party
angles.copy: Notting Hill Carnival is almost here! Get ready for the UK's biggest celebration of Caribbean culture. What's your favourite part?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The last Bank Holiday of the summer for England, Wales and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Long Weekend Ahead
angles.copy: The final Bank Holiday of the summer is just around the corner! What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: Making the Most of It
angles.copy: Don't forget, it's the August Bank Holiday this weekend for England, Wales & Northern Ireland. Time for one last summer hurrah!
